units.source_text: 卖蛋人被偷了盐，马上站起来，说了句“滚！畜生”。

en.t: When the egg seller had his salt stolen, he immediately stood up and said, "Get lost! You animal."

units.source_text: 撒盐的小孩儿就冲着卖蛋人“嘿”的一声，

en.t: The child who had scattered the salt gave a quick "hey" toward the egg seller,

units.source_text: 然后将胳膊搭在刚才那位舔了盐的孩子的脖颈上，

en.t: then put his arm around the neck of the child who had just licked the salt,

units.source_text: 并肩钻入人流，无影无踪了。

en.t: and the two slipped shoulder to shoulder into the crowd and vanished without a trace.
